title: CrsCheck
description: One CRS identity and fraud check of a seller, as a band only. Never carries raw report fields (scores, SSN, addresses): additionalProperties is false on purpose. Emitted by the CRS adapter (Lane A, #15); consumed by pay.crs_gate.

verified.description: True only when the check passed. A blocked or failed check is false.

reason_codes.description: Short machine codes for why a check failed (for example risk_score_high, email_new). Empty when verified.

persona_id.description: CRS sandbox test persona, for example P19. Sandbox identities only.

checked_at.description: UTC, ends in Z. A check older than 24 hours no longer clears a business payee.

request_id.description: CRS RequestID response header, when there is one.

origin.description: NOT_CONFIGURED means no CRS credentials: the check never ran and never clears a payee.
